coverage: 2000-present: comprehensive Governor archive from August 24, 2021, and selected earlier orders still in force from the Past Executive Orders page; plus 49 weather disaster orders added by hand: 9 Pataki orders (2000-2006), 1 Spitzer order (2007) and 5 Paterson orders (2008-2010) from 9 NYCRR Parts 5, 6 and 7, and 34 Cuomo orders, 29 of them (2011-2019) from 9 NYCRR Part 8 and 5 (2017-2020) from the New York State Register. Every federal declaration from 2011 on has a matching state order. No state order is kept for 13 federal declarations from 2000-2010: DR-1335, EM-3173, DR-1486, EM-3195, DR-1534, DR-1564, DR-1565 and DR-1670 (Pataki, 2000-2006); DR-1692, DR-1710 and DR-1724 (Spitzer, 2007); DR-1869 and DR-1957 (Paterson, 2009-2010). 9 NYCRR Parts 5, 6 and 7 print these governors' executive orders and were read in full; none declares a disaster for any of the 13, so the state appears to have relied on the federal declaration alone. Four more match only by date, to orders for other storms: DR-1899 (the March 2010 nor'easter) to 9 NYCRR 7.37 (February 24-26, 2010), DR-1943 (the September 16, 2010 storms) to 7.40 (September 29 to October 1, 2010), and DR-4031 and EM-3341 (Tropical Storm Lee, September 2011) to 8.17 (Hurricane Irene)
